claim_scores.rationale: Defines `Address`, `ContactInfo`, `UserProfile`, and `Note`, plus `complex_tool(profile: UserProfile, priority: int, notes: list[Note] | None = None)` to cover deep nesting and optional list-of-models.
Builds `tool = dspy.Tool(complex_tool)` and inspects `tool.args` as the generated argument schema, which is the DSPy path exercised by the cited implementation.
Asserts the `profile` schema is an object and directly checks nested `contact.properties.email.type == "string"`, showing the nested object is inlined.
Asserts `notes` keeps the nullable `anyOf` form and that the array-items schema directly exposes `content` and `author` as string properties.
Explicitly asserts `"$defs" not in str(tool.args["notes"])`, matching the expected reference-resolution behavior.
